Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

Provenance: identify authored code, reconstructed native behavior, recovered
script/resource use, and any external dependency involved.

Validation: list checks actually run and their scope. Separate synthetic
fixtures, original native comparisons, render checks and live gameplay.

Remaining limits: identify temporary approximations and incomplete interfaces.
Keep original game files, recovered sources, raw native exports and local
packages out of the pull request.
